savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14089 in full (secs. 1-6): it revokes or amends no order, transfers no function, fund or property and creates no right (sec. 6(d)). It created an advisory council in the Department of State whose appointments are made by the Secretary of State for 2-year terms without compensation; the Council, its terms and its advice function ended with the order. The one residual lead is EO 14109 sec. 1(cc), which continued the Council as a FACA committee until 2025-09-30 and was not itself revoked by EO 14148; that continuance only extends a committee that Executive Order 14089 established and supplies no separate mandate, appointment power or duty, and EO 14148 is the later and specific act ending the order, so no continuing effect is found. research_rationale: EO 14089 (signed 2022-12-13, 87 FR 77459-77461), read in full from the held official FR text, states the policy (sec. 1), directs the Secretary of State to establish the President's Advisory Council on African Diaspora Engagement within 180 days (sec. 2), fixes membership, 2-year member terms, a Chair and Executive Director (sec. 3), functions (sec. 4), administration with quarterly meetings (sec. 5) and general provisions including FACA (sec. 6). It has no termination or sunset clause. EO 14148 sec. 2(aaa) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes it with no effective-date wording, effective on signing 2025-01-20. Dossier missing lines read: (1) EO 14109 (88 FR 68447, read in full; effective 2023-09-29 under its sec. 6) sec. 1(cc) continues the Council until 2025-09-30; it is attached as a later event to the Council clauses (secs. 2 through 6(a)); it extends the committee's FACA life, amends no text, and the continuance date falls after the 2025-01-20 revocation, so it does not move the first end. (2) EO 13985 (held official text) does not name EO 14089; EO 14089 sec. 4(b)(i) only refers to the efforts coordinated under EO 13985, and EO 13985 was revoked by EO 14148 sec. 2(a) on the same day, so it changes nothing earlier and is ruled out. The 2-year member terms are not an end of the clauses. The inventory is the dossier's 22 contiguous clauses from sec. 1 to the signature line and is kept. No other held official text names EO 14089. Savings: none found.
